reason: E1 supports the premise that a BCC matrix with B2 precipitates improves ductility, and E3 supports that second phases can trap He, but there is no cited evidence that Ti forms B2 precipitates in NbMoTaW, that such precipitates are stable at 1600 °C, or that they reduce shear stress, leaving several key premises unsupported.
premises: A BCC matrix with discrete B2 precipitates improves ductility over a B2 matrix with BCC precipitates
Ti addition to NbMoTaW can form B2/Ti-rich precipitates
Second-phase precipitates can trap He bubbles and improve irradiation tolerance
Nanoscale precipitates can remain stable up to 1600 °C
Precipitates can locally reduce critical resolved shear stress to improve ductility
